high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from the website news18.com. The article is titled "A Very 'Civil' Engineer: IISc Professor Madhavi Latha Spent 17 Years Building Chenab Bridge." It is curated by Pathikrit Sen Gupta from News18.com and was last updated on June 08, 2025, at 08:18 IST. The text in the article mentions that Professor Madhavi Latha's team adopted a "design-as-you-go" philosophy, continuously adapting and innovating in real time while building the Chenab Bridge.
